summary: Reduce Actions minutes and Copilot spend via issue-event job guards, opt-in PLATE_COPILOT_AUTOSTART, PR concurrency, and main-only push deploys.
migration_impact: Adopter repos should re-import template workflows; Copilot autostart is off until PLATE_COPILOT_AUTOSTART=true.
migration_guidance: Run gh plate import-payload (or upgrade) and merge the .github/workflows diff.
Leave PLATE_COPILOT_AUTOSTART unset (or false) unless automatic @copilot kickoff is desired.
Confirm branch protection still lists ci, pr-issue-link-check, pr-title-check, label-check (issues), feedback-resolution-check, release, and publish workflows as before.
Follow docs/migration/actions-cost-rollout.md for private adopter rollout order.
agent_notes: Issue workflows use job-level if: to skip runners on irrelevant events. plates-start-feature and plates-unblock-features omit @copilot unless PLATE_COPILOT_AUTOSTART=true. PR workflows use concurrency with cancel-in-progress except release/publish.
